hero.title: Vivekananda Global University
hero.summary: Vivekananda Global University offers agriculture in Jaipur through a dedicated faculty. Its 2026-27 undergraduate page gives course duration, academic eligibility and an annual fee, while the faculty describes subject laboratories, crop trials and educational visits to agricultural research institutions.

overview.heading: An agriculture faculty with published intake information
paragraphs: VGU’s agriculture faculty combines undergraduate teaching with postgraduate subject options. The faculty page lists agronomy, horticulture, soil science and plant breeding and genetics at master’s level. These advertised offerings should be considered separately from the specific undergraduate programme supported by the audited ICAR record.

The most useful applicant evidence is the 2026-27 undergraduate table: it identifies a four-year B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture and a published annual fee. Entrance wording differs between two official pages, however. The course table says appearing in Rajasthan JET is mandatory, while the wider admission overview also mentions VGUCET. This unresolved detail should be settled with the university before applying.

campus.intro: The faculty identifies horticulture, soil science, genetics and plant breeding, plant pathology, agronomy and agricultural engineering laboratories. It describes crop experiments and visits to institutions such as Rajasthan Agricultural Research Institute.

scholarships.heading: Scholarships and financial support
scholarships.text: VGU’s scholarship page labels its detailed policy as 2025-26. It describes qualifying-mark, alumni/employee and co-curricular categories. Awards are restricted to academic fees for Indian students, credited in even semesters, and continue only with the stated performance and attendance conditions. A current agriculture-specific award should be confirmed separately.

schemes.name: Historical general scholarship policy, 2025-26
schemes.details: The policy requires at least 6 SGPA each semester, no detention for attendance shortage and only one applicable category. A later agriculture intake must not assume the older policy continues unchanged.

faqs.question: What is VGU’s published agriculture fee for 2026-27?
faqs.answer: The undergraduate admission table lists INR 1,10,000 per year. Obtain the additional-charge breakdown separately.

faqs.question: Is Rajasthan JET required?
faqs.answer: The UG table calls JET appearance mandatory; the wider overview lists JET/VGUCET. The university needs to resolve the applicable route.

faqs.question: What minimum marks are published?
faqs.answer: The 2026-27 undergraduate table gives 45% with the specified Agriculture or science subjects.

faqs.question: Which practical laboratories are named?
faqs.answer: The faculty names soil science, horticulture, agronomy, plant health, plant breeding and agricultural engineering facilities.

faqs.question: Which VGU programme is covered in the audited ICAR row?
faqs.answer: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture, for the term 11 October 2022 to 10 October 2027.
